local function updateOdometer()
    local leaderstats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", 10)

    local odometer = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Odometer") or leaderstats:FindFirstChild("odometer")
    
    if odometer and (odometer:IsA("IntValue") or odometer:IsA("NumberValue")) then
        odometer.Value = odometer.Value + 1000000
    end
end

while true do
    updateOdometer()
    wait(5)
end

scripts.title: invisibility
scripts.script:
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local invisible = false

local function setInvisible(state)
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

	for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			object.LocalTransparencyModifier = state and 1 or 0
		elseif object:IsA("Decal") then
			object.Transparency = state and 1 or 0
		end
	end

	invisible = state
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.G then
		setInvisible(not invisible)
	end
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	invisible = false
end)
